name: Data Analyzer: Full analysis of a small employee table is run (outcome not enforced)
objective: Runs load-and-analyze on made-up data with one planted age error. The test catches every error and only returns a value, so it passes whether or not the analysis works; it does not prove the age error is found.
precondition: Offline test harness. NOTE: this test cannot fail on a quality problem; see objective.

steps.action: Load made-up CSV, run all checks with schema and rules
steps.data: 5 employees; one age of 150 against a 18-65 rule; salary and department rules
steps.expected: Nothing is asserted. Results are printed; any error is caught and the test still passes

name: Data Analyzer: Analysis runs on JSON and Excel-style tables (outcome not enforced)
objective: Runs the checks on a JSON-loaded table and a table built to resemble Excel. Errors are caught and printed, so the test always passes.
precondition: Offline test harness. NOTE: this test cannot fail on a quality problem; see objective.

steps.action: Load made-up JSON, run checks; then run checks on a made-up product table
steps.data: 3 score rows as JSON; 3 product rows
steps.expected: Nothing is asserted; failures are caught and only printed

name: Data Analyzer: Row count, type, range and summary checks are run on a flawed table (outcome not enforced)
objective: Runs the individual checks on made-up data with duplicates, missing values and bad ages. Nothing is asserted and errors are caught, so it always passes.
precondition: Offline test harness. NOTE: this test cannot fail on a quality problem; see objective.

steps.action: Run row count, type, range and summary checks
steps.data: 5 made-up rows with a duplicate id, blank values, ages 200 and -5, mixed-case status
steps.expected: Nothing is asserted; results are printed only

name: Data Analyzer: Automatic detection of column types is exercised (assertions are swallowed)
objective: Intends to show integers, decimals, text, dates and true/false are recognised. The checks sit inside a catch-all error handler, so a wrong answer is printed but the test still passes.
precondition: Offline test harness. NOTE: this test cannot fail on a quality problem; see objective.

steps.action: Detect types for six made-up columns
steps.data: int, decimal, text, ISO date and true/false columns, plus a mixed column
steps.expected: Intended: int, float, str, datetime, bool detected. In practice any mismatch is caught and the test still passes
